# Berman Electric LLC

> Licensed electrician serving Suffolk County, Long Island, NY. Residential and commercial electrical services including EV charger installation, panel upgrades, lighting, rewiring, repairs, and emergency calls. Free estimates. Lifetime workmanship warranty.

Berman Electric is a local, licensed electrical contractor based in Ronkonkoma, New York, owned and operated by Rob Berman. The company specializes in residential and small commercial electrical work across Suffolk County, Long Island. All work is backed by a lifetime workmanship warranty. Estimates are free and transparent.

## Services

- [Services](/services): Full list of electrical services offered, from EV chargers to full-home rewiring.
- [EV Charger Installation](/services/ev-charger-installation): Level 2 EV charger installation for homes and businesses, including Tesla, ChargePoint, and universal options.
- [EV Charger Installation — Long Island](/services/ev-charger-installation-long-island): EV charging solutions tailored for Long Island homeowners and HOAs.
- [Panel Upgrades](/services/panel-upgrades): Electrical panel replacement and 200-amp upgrades for modern power demands.
- [Panel Upgrades — Long Island](/services/panel-upgrades-long-island): 200-amp service upgrades across Suffolk and Nassau counties.
- [Lighting Installation](/services/lighting-installation): Recessed, landscape, under-cabinet, and LED lighting design and install.
- [Electrical Repairs](/services/electrical-repairs): Troubleshooting, outlet repair, circuit issues, and code corrections.
- [Outlets & Switches](/services/outlets-switches): Installation, replacement, GFCI/AFCI upgrades, and smart switch setups.
- [Home Rewiring](/services/home-rewiring): Whole-house and partial rewiring for safety, renovations, and code compliance.
- [Emergency Electrical](/services/emergency-electrical): 24/7 emergency electrical service for Suffolk County residents.
